text.title: 还缺日期的预览页
text.situation:
发布台上，诺拉打开网站预览页。人物简介介绍了节目里发言的志愿者。配图展示侧门和楼上的房间，没有只放一张图书馆全景。乔逐项确认时间表是最新的。下一份刊物明早送印，不过有一项活动仍缺确切开始时间。她们注明待确认，没有自行填写。诺拉像新读者一样逐页查看，发现一条图注指错门口，乔在送出文件前改正。熟悉的图片和熟悉的词一样，也可能误导人。

乔：最后一项活动有确切时间吗？
诺拉：还没有，在预览页里讲清楚。
乔：我更新了图片和时间表。

paragraphs.en: At the publication desk, Nora opened the website preview. A short profile introduced the volunteer whose voice appeared in the programme. The visuals showed the side gate and the room upstairs, rather than a general photograph of the library. Jo checked that every timetable was up-to-date. The next publication would go to the printer the following morning, but one activity still lacked a definite starting time. They marked it as awaiting confirmation instead of filling the space. Nora clicked through the page as a new reader might. When a caption pointed to the wrong doorway, Jo corrected it before sending the file. A familiar image could mislead as easily as a familiar word.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Is there a definite time for the last activity?
Nora: Not yet. Keep that clear in the preview.
Jo: I have updated the visuals and the timetable.

acceptableAnswers: 简介介绍了志愿者。 网站刊登了修改后的时间表。

S16.N12.P02.cue: 说明刊物和最新时间表。
acceptableAnswers: 下一份刊物明早送印。 乔核查时间表是否最新。

S16.N12.P03.cue: 说说图片展示什么，以及哪项还未确定。
